fixture_rules.deal_stage: Keep the deal in proposal until the customer explicitly confirms that commercial or legal negotiation has begun; do not advance on vague progress.
fixture_rules.next_step: Record a concrete action when owner and deadline are explicit.
fixture_rules.close_date: Do not assign or change a specific close date from vague timing or an unconfirmed estimate.
fixture_rules.amount: When explicit customer statements conflict about amount, show a conflict and require a user decision without preselecting a value.
fixture_rules.notes: Add material process ownership or unresolved commercial facts when explicitly supported, while preserving uncertainty.
